terms.comment: For the ordinary modern blanket, Traupman (p. 122), Morgan–Owens and Vicipaedia agree on lōdīx.

phrases.english: Shall I cover you with the blanket?

phrases.latin: quī nōn sub lōdīce jacēbat, sed in culcitā saliēbat, in caput sē volvēbat, cachinnābat, cervīcālia in patrem conjiciēbat
phrases.english: who was not lying under the blanket but jumping on the mattress, doing somersaults, cackling and throwing the pillows at Dad
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus
